items.title: Phil Flanigan interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: the original quartet, which was without piano, just Flory on guitar, Riggs on drums, myself and Hamilton, and with the addition of Wilber on soprano and alto and clarinet

ctx.x: Well when did the first record date come about?

That was something that Bob Wilber instigated for the Chiaroscuro label. He heard us play at Eddie Condon’s and he was blown away that all these young guys — we were all under 25 then I guess — were playing this style music, so he got a date and he put — the original quartet, which was without piano, just Flory on guitar, Riggs on drums, myself and Hamilton, and with the addition of Wilber on soprano and alto and clarinet, but one at a time thankfully.
Yeah. That would be a little Roland Kirky.
